# ai-provider-status-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: ai-provider-status. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/ai-provider-status

toolsPreview.name: get_all_status
toolsPreview.description: Get real-time status for all AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI). Returns overall health, component status and active incidents.

toolsPreview.name: get_provider_status
toolsPreview.description: Get real-time status for a single AI provider.

toolsPreview.name: get_incidents
toolsPreview.description: Get active incidents across all AI providers. Optionally filter by provider.
